disposition_rationale: DL-039 Step 9 individual semantic adjudication at 2026-09-25T03:50:05Z: Jared answered EA-S09B2-SPAWN-REQUEST-001 with option 1 on 2026-09-25 (Plans/Decision_Log.md#DL-088): subagent.spawn_requested and subagent.spawn_completed are retired, and Puppet Master records no start request separately from the subagent it creates. The Contracts owner edit that removes the name from Plans/Contracts_V0.md:1469, 2983, CV-116 and CV-266 is still pending. This records the exclusion of this exact token from the persisted-family campaign as retired; it creates no alias, deletes no history and changes no registered family. Application: reports/event-authority-20260911/step-09-batch2-card-answer-application-20260925.json. The legacy CPU bucket and cohort pins remain because the frozen schema and validator have no J248 exclusion category. No denominator removal, contract-depth pass or seal is claimed.
